experiment: T1-1 X-H4 multi-year decayed xHEM+ (forward column)

conventions.predictor: decay-and-PA-weighted mean of per-season Savant est_woba over y-2..y, weight_i = d_i * PA_i; most-recent season gets the largest d
conventions.target: next-season (Y+1) actual wOBA computed from cached fa_statsapi_hitting_YYYY.json via hitter_export + hem_plus._raw_woba linear weights
conventions.eligibility: Savant PA >= 200 in predictor year y AND StatsAPI PA >= 200 in outcome year y+1 AND >= 2-season Savant history in the y-2..y window
conventions.incumbent_b_actual_woba_source: Savant per-season actual 'woba' column, flat PA-weighted over the same window
conventions.bootstrap: player-paired: resample players, each carries all his pairs

gate.bar: rho(primary d=5/4/3) > BOTH recomputed incumbents AND seeded 2000-rep player-paired bootstrap gap vs the STRONGER incumbent lo95 >= 0

loss_ledger.gate: rho(primary d=5/4/3) > both recomputed incumbents AND player-paired bootstrap lo95 >= 0 vs stronger incumbent (seed 20260705, 2000 reps)
loss_ledger.outcome: leg 1 PASS (+0.0203 vs 1yr xwOBA, +0.0110 vs flat-3yr actual), leg 2 FAIL (lo95 -0.0148)
loss_ledger.reading: multi-year pooling does the heavy lifting; xwOBA-vs-actual and decay-shape increments over a flat 3yr actual-wOBA blend are noise-level at n=1495
loss_ledger.do_not_retry_without: a materially larger pair set (2026+2027 outcomes) or a pre-registered variance-reduction design; the point gap is real but unresolvable at this n
